content: US-Nevada requires an additional identity validation step before any withdrawal or payment authorization completes. Tests covering those flows must run with the Nevada validation profile enabled.
US-Nevada enforces a maximum single-withdrawal limit. A withdrawal above the limit must be rejected before it reaches the payment provider.
EU flows must apply Strong Customer Authentication to payment authorization. A 3DS challenge is expected rather than optional.
UK flows must display gambling-spend affordability messaging before a withdrawal is confirmed.
Safari is not certified for the Nevada validation profile, so US-Nevada coverage is limited to Chrome and Firefox.
